# evroc_project_quota (Data Source)

Retrieves quota limits and current usage for a project.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `object_storage_total_size` (String) Maximum total object storage size (e.g., "5TB" or "unlimited").
- `object_storage_usage` (String) Current object storage usage.
